Phone agent editor: ✨ Write with AI, pick the writer

Mock-up v2, 2026-11-10. Change from v1: you pick which AI writes the brief. Built from the real phone app's screen and styles (Agents → Reviewer, a sample agent on a test Mac). Only the Brief area is new; everything else is today's editor, unchanged.

1Type a few words

Same as v1, plus a “Written by” pick under the box. It starts on the agent’s own AI.

How it behaves

  • No new tab. The button sits on the Brief row in the editor that's already there, for both changing an agent and making a new one.
  • New in v2: Written by. A small pick under the Brief box. It starts on the agent's own AI each time you open the editor. The list is the same one the Mac's “Written by” menu shows: the coding AIs turned on on that Mac, then your saved agents. The names in frame 2 are examples; the real list comes from the Mac.
  • The chosen AI only writes the brief. It doesn't change which AI the agent runs on; that is still set by the Model row below.
  • Whichever AI writes it gets read-only access and none of its own brief, same as on the Mac.
  • The button is greyed out while the Brief box is empty.
  • On a new agent with the Name left blank, the AI fills in the name too. A name you typed is never replaced.
  • After writing, the box grows to show the whole brief (frame 4). Today it's fixed at 4 lines.
  • Nothing is saved until you tap Save agent. Closing the sheet throws away an answer that hasn't arrived yet.
  • On phones with less than Full access the whole agent editor is already locked, so there's no separate greyed-out state.
